notes.title: Limited Time Free Demo, Unlimited Chaos!
notes.content:
Hey fighters! The moment you've been waiting for is almost here, Amer Fighting Free Demo is available from 1st Oct to 12th Oct Get ready to mess around with some cool new features we've been cooking up — stay tuned!A crazy new grab mechanic so you can pick up players and YEET them!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235616/e510a81faee4dc448d8a9372e393124faf2d1157.gif"]
A totally new Boat map to duke it out on.  Splash into fights on a colorful cruise deck packed with floaties, pool toys, umbrellas, and plenty of spots to throw hands or friends! Whether you’re slipping by the pool, dodging punches near a beach chair, or launching someone off the top deck, it’s nonstop action with a side of vacation vibes.
